name: Apex Solventless | 0.5g Live Rosin O2 Disposable | Lilikoi #6
description: Lilikoi is an extraordinary hybrid that blends the vibrant, exotic flavors of Zoap with the tropical sweetness of Strawguava x Expiration Date. This strain is a sensory delight, offering a complex flavor profile that’s both refreshing and rich. With its balanced effects and irresistible tropical essence, Lilikoi is the perfect choice for those seeking an uplifting yet calming cannabis experience.
